purpose: Railway must check schedule before allowing characters in scenes. Schedule files are placeholders until filled by author.

if_schedule_empty.rule: Do not invent exact raids/classes. Use only current_state and explicit scene data. Ambient NPCs may appear only from location rules, not named main characters.
if_schedule_empty.main_characters: available only if current_state/scene_contract explicitly places them there
if_schedule_empty.ambient_staff: allowed only by location tag and broad activity window if defined
